Test Dental, family dentist in Testville

Test Dental is a family dentist in Testville offering check-ups, emergency care and children's dentistry six days a week.

How much does a check-up cost?

A check-up and clean costs $200, including x-rays. Health fund rebates are processed on the spot.

Do you see children?

Yes, we see children from age two, and the first visit is free.
